items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: The letter states a separate posting date ("Abgesandt am 20.11.2026", a Friday), which counts as the relevant day instead of the printed letter date. Per § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary post is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting (posting on/after 1 Jan 2025): Fri 20.11 (day 0, not counted) -> Sat 21.11 (day1) -> Sun 22.11 (day2) -> Mon 23.11 (day3) -> Tue 24.11.2026 (day4). Since this is a Finanzamt, if the 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO), but 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday, a normal working day, so Bekanntgabe = 24.11.2026. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§355 Abs.1 AO) then runs under §188 Abs.2 BGB: the day of delivery is not counted; the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a normal working day in Germany (not a holiday), and Thursday is not a weekend, so the deadline does not shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
